metadata.title: Payment Platforms of New Online Sellers, 2023–2026: AI Sellers Make Up a Far Larger Share on Merchant of Record Platforms than on Stripe (Evidence from 200,000 Checkout Links and a $20 Cross-Border Subscription Fee Comparison)
metadata.description:
What changed in this version (version 1.1, 22 November 2026). No counts, shares or fees changed. Version 1.0, titled "The Structural Shift from Payment Gateways to Merchant of Record Platforms Among Independent Software and AI Founders", read the platform shares as AI founders preferring Merchant of Record platforms. The shares describe the mix of sellers within each platform: Stripe, being far larger, still has more AI sellers in absolute numbers (7% of 102,590 is about 7,200, against 2,354 new sellers of any kind on Dodo Payments, Polar and Creem combined). The title now says what the data show. Version 1.1 also states that Waffo Pancake's $20 total leaves out its 1% payout fee while other totals include one, dates the start of the 2026 rise in the AI share correctly, presents Paddle's undercount as an inference, credits Liu Xiaopai's published breakdown as the source of most fee rows, and describes the data as archived on Zenodo.

Using DataForSEO's link graph to count about 200,000 checkout links on 198,000 websites that link directly to hosted checkout pages on seven payment platforms (Stripe Payment Links, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments, Creem and classic Paddle links), combined with an itemized fee comparison for a $20/month international AI SaaS subscription, this working paper documents four patterns between 2023 and 15 October 2026. New sellers per year rose from 21,000 in 2023 and 29,000 in 2024 to 56,000 in 2025 and 82,000 through 15 October 2026, counting only websites that still linked in October 2026. Software's share of new sellers rose from a 6%–8% plateau in 2025 to 20% in September 2026, and AI products from 2% (2023) to 12% (September 2026). AI products make up a far larger share of new sellers on the Merchant of Record platforms Dodo Payments (29%), Polar (27%) and Creem (24%) than on Stripe (7%) or Gumroad (8%), though Stripe has more AI sellers in absolute numbers. On one $20 international subscription with all surcharges counted, several MoR setups keep more than a Hong Kong Stripe stack with Billing, Tax and Radar.
